title: The Platinum-Amber Descent
summary: In the forgotten capital, a youth navigates an inhuman, stupid past, tricked by chuffles and logjams. With her jetpack haywire, she pondered cryptic warnings about a rathole, consuming hummus and kimchee. Her everydays were disrupted by a blowfly's buzz and a frantic jackrabbit's dart. She nursed a deep cut after a freaky, fracked junkyard encounter, facing an obese prowler who twisted the Kajawah bridge. She roughly handpicked parts, understanding the invidious plot. Now, she descends by parachute into a windy plain, her underhand dealings unveiled. She grasps the basics, her jabs and jargons becoming new mantras, finding solace in the earthy verticality and distant neons.
protagonist: a teenager with asymmetric platinum-and-amber braids, a cracked jade compass on a leather cord, oil-stained mechanic coveralls

Tendril-like neons from a distant turnkey facility cut through the powder-fine dust, creating verticality from the earthy landscape.
